name: Poynting owner theorem
statement: For S_MH[A,g_obs], Hilbert variation gives T_EM. The Poynting vector S_i=-T_EM(n,e_i) is already EM energy flux in T_total, so a standalone Poynting source coefficient is a double count: c_Poynt_extra=0 if the single source functional is parent-signed.
guard: This closes the common Poynting-as-hidden-force shortcut but not all EM residuals.

name: Dq_EM component zero
statement: Dq_EM[Hperp]=0 follows if the visible EM readout/action factors through q before variation, Maxwell-Hodge uses the same observed coframe/Hodge, charge/material constants are q-basic, no MTS visible-sector residual exists, and radiative flux is boundary-routed.
guard: Needs Hperp/H_L argument certificate plus visible EM residual vector zero.

name: Dq_EM fallback envelope
statement: epsilon_EM <= sum_abs(delta_w_EM, C_XF2, C_JQ, b_alpha, dlnlambda, b_marker, Delta_Hodge_EM, Delta_rad_Poynting, Delta_internal_exchange, c_Poynt_extra) plus normalization by the relevant source/readout scale.
guard: No cancellation between EM residual channels.

name: Delta_Hodge priority
statement: Delta_Hodge_EM is the first EM subgate because Hodge uniqueness is mathematical once g_obs/e_obs/orientation and the parent-visible Maxwell action domain are signed.
guard: Gauge covariance alone does not force chi_EM=chi(g_obs).
